name: @activepieces/piece-groq
description: Use Groq's fast language models and audio processing capabilities.

ask-ai.name: ask-ai
ask-ai.description: Ask Groq anything using fast language models.

model.description: The model which will generate the completion.

temperature.description: Controls randomness: Lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.

maxTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. The total length of input tokens and generated tokens is limited by the model's context length.

topP.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

frequencyPenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

presencePenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

memoryKey.description: A memory key that will keep the chat history shared across runs and flows. Keep it empty to leave Groq without memory of previous messages.

roles.description: Array of roles to specify more accurate response

aiMetadata.description: Sends a prompt to a Groq-hosted chat model (Whisper speech models are excluded from the model list) and returns the generated text, with optional sampling controls and a roles array for system instructions. Runs stateless by default, or shares conversation history across runs and flows when a memory key is set. This is the only text-generation action in the piece - pick the sibling Transcribe Audio or Translate Audio actions when the input is a sound file rather than text. Requires a model, a question, and a maximum token count; not idempotent: each call produces a fresh completion and, when a memory key is set, appends to the stored project-scoped history.

transcribe-audio.name: transcribe-audio
transcribe-audio.description: Transcribes audio into text in the input language.

file.description: The audio file to transcribe. Supported formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.

model.description: The model to use for transcription.

language.description: The language of the input audio in ISO-639-1 format (e.g., "en" for English). This will improve accuracy and latency.

prompt.description: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The prompt should match the audio language.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

responseFormat.description: The format of the transcript output.

aiMetadata.description: Runs Groq speech-to-text (Whisper) over an uploaded audio file and returns the spoken content transcribed in its original language; a response-format prop switches between plain text, JSON, and verbose JSON with segment timings. Choose this over the sibling Translate Audio action whenever the transcript must stay in the language that was spoken, since Translate Audio always renders English. Requires an audio file (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm) and a Whisper model, with an optional ISO-639-1 language hint that improves accuracy; not idempotent: each call re-runs the model and may return slightly different text.

file.description: The audio file to translate. Supported formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.

model.description: The model to use for translation.

prompt.description: An optional text in English to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

responseFormat.description: The format of the translation output.

aiMetadata.description: Runs Groq speech-to-text (Whisper) over an uploaded audio file and returns the spoken content as English text, translating from whatever language was spoken; a response-format prop switches between plain text, JSON, and verbose JSON with segment timings. Pick this only when English output is wanted - the target language cannot be changed, and the sibling Transcribe Audio action keeps the transcript in the original spoken language. Requires an audio file (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm) and a Whisper model; not idempotent: each call re-runs the model and may return slightly different text.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

nl.Use Groq's fast language models and audi: Gebruik Groq's snelle taalmodellen en geluidsverwerkingsmogelijkheden.

nl.Transcribes audio into text in the input: Audio-overdracht in tekst in de invoertaal.

nl.Question: Vraag
nl.The model which will generate the comple: Het model dat de voltooiing zal genereren.
nl.Controls randomness: Lowering results in: Bestuurt willekeurigheid: Het verlagen van de temperatuur resulteert in minder willekeurige aanvullingen. Zodra de temperatuur nul nadert, zal het model deterministisch en herhalend worden.
nl.The maximum number of tokens to generate: Het maximale aantal tokens om te genereren. De totale lengte van de ingangstokens en gegenereerde tokens wordt beperkt door de context lengte van het model.
nl.An alternative to sampling with temperat: Een alternatief voor bemonstering met de temperatuur, genaamd nucleus sampling, waarbij het model de resultaten van de tokens met top_p waarschijnlijkheid ziet. 0.1 betekent dus dat alleen de tokens die de grootste massa van 10 procent vormen, worden overwogen.
nl.Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive va: Nummer tussen -2.0 en 2.0. Positieve waarden bestraffen nieuwe tokens op basis van hun bestaande frequentie in de tekst tot nu toe, waardoor de waarschijnlijkheid van het model om dezelfde lijn te herhalen afneemt.

Nummer tussen -2.0 en 2.0. Positieve waarden bestraffen nieuwe tokens op basis van de vraag of ze tot nu toe in de tekst staan, waardoor de waarschijnlijkheid van het model om over nieuwe onderwerpen te praten toeneemt.
nl.A memory key that will keep the chat his: Een geheugensleutel waarmee de chatgeschiedenis gedeeld blijft over uitvoeringen en stromen. Houd deze leeg om Groq zonder geheugen van vorige berichten te verlaten.
nl.Array of roles to specify more accurate: Array of roles om een nauwkeuriger antwoord te geven
nl.The audio file to transcribe. Supported: Het audiobestand om te converteren. Ondersteunde formaten: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.
Het te gebruiken model voor transcriptie.
nl.The language of the input audio in ISO-6: De taal van het invoergeluid in ISO-639-1 formaat (bijv. "en" voor het Engels). Dit verbetert de nauwkeurigheid en latentie.
nl.An optional text to guide the model's st: Een optionele tekst om de stijl van het model te begeleiden of door te gaan met een vorig audiosegment. De vraag moet overeenkomen met de audiotaal.
nl.The sampling temperature, between 0 and: De monstertemperatuur tussen 0 en 1. Hogere waarden zoals 0. zal de uitvoer willekeuriger maken, terwijl lagere waarden zoals 0,2 deze gerichter en deterministischer maken.
Het formaat van de transcript uitvoer.
nl.The audio file to translate. Supported f: Het audiobestand om te vertalen. Ondersteunde formaten: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.
Het te gebruiken model voor vertaling.
nl.An optional text in English to guide the: Een optionele tekst in het Engels om de stijl van het model te begeleiden of door te gaan met een vorig audiosegment.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.

fr.Use Groq's fast language models and audi: Utilisez les modèles de langage rapide de Groq et les capacités de traitement audio.

fr.Question: Question
fr.The model which will generate the comple: Le modèle qui va générer la complétion.
fr.Controls randomness: Lowering results in: Contrôle aléatoirement : La baisse des résultats est moins aléatoire, alors que la température approche de zéro, le modèle devient déterministe et répétitif.
fr.The maximum number of tokens to generate: Le nombre maximum de jetons à générer. La longueur totale des jetons d'entrée et des jetons générés est limitée par la longueur de contexte du modèle.
fr.An alternative to sampling with temperat: Une alternative à l'échantillonnage à la température, appelée l'échantillonnage du noyau, où le modèle considère les résultats des jetons avec la masse de probabilité top_p. Ainsi, 0,1 signifie que seuls les jetons constituant la masse de probabilité la plus élevée de 10% sont pris en compte.
fr.Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive va: Numéroter entre -2.0 et 2.0. Les valeurs positives pénalisent les nouveaux jetons en fonction de leur fréquence existante dans le texte jusqu'à présent, diminuant la probabilité du modèle de répéter le verbatim de la même ligne.

Numéroter entre -2.0 et 2.0. Les valeurs positives pénalisent les nouveaux jetons en fonction de leur apparition dans le texte jusqu'à présent, ce qui augmente la probabilité du modèle de parler de nouveaux sujets.
fr.A memory key that will keep the chat his: Une clé de mémoire qui conservera l'historique des discussions partagées à travers les exécutions et les flux. Gardez-la vide pour laisser Groq sans mémoire pour les messages précédents.
fr.Array of roles to specify more accurate: Tableau de rôles pour spécifier une réponse plus précise
fr.The audio file to transcribe. Supported: Le fichier audio à transcrire. Les formats supportés : flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.
Le modèle à utiliser pour la transcription.
fr.The language of the input audio in ISO-6: La langue de l'audio d'entrée au format ISO-639-1 (par exemple, "en" pour l'anglais). Cela améliorera la précision et la latence.
fr.An optional text to guide the model's st: Un texte optionnel pour guider le style du modèle ou continuer un segment audio précédent. L'invite doit correspondre à la langue audio.
fr.The sampling temperature, between 0 and: La température d'échantillonnage entre 0 et 1. Des valeurs plus élevées comme 0. rendra la sortie plus aléatoire, tandis que des valeurs plus basses comme 0.2 la rendront plus concentrée et déterministe.
Le format de sortie de la transcription.

es.Controls randomness: Lowering results in: Controles aleatorios: La reducción de resultados en terminaciones menos aleatorias. A medida que la temperatura se acerca a cero, el modelo se volverá determinista y repetitivo.
es.The maximum number of tokens to generate: El número máximo de fichas a generar. La longitud total de las fichas de entrada y las fichas generadas está limitada por la longitud del contexto del modelo.
es.An alternative to sampling with temperat: Una alternativa al muestreo con temperatura, llamado muestreo de núcleos, donde el modelo considera los resultados de los tokens con masa de probabilidad superior_p. es.Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive va: Número entre -2.0 y 2.0. Los valores positivos penalizan nuevos tokens basados en su frecuencia existente en el texto hasta ahora, lo que reduce la probabilidad del modelo de repetir la misma línea literalmente.
Número entre -2.0 y 2.0. Los valores positivos penalizan las nuevas fichas basándose en si aparecen en el texto hasta ahora, lo que aumenta la probabilidad de que el modelo hable de nuevos temas.
es.A memory key that will keep the chat his: Una clave de memoria que mantendrá el historial de chat compartido entre ejecuciones y flujos. Manténgalo vacío para dejar Groq sin memoria de mensajes anteriores.
es.Array of roles to specify more accurate: Matriz de roles para especificar una respuesta más precisa

es.An optional text to guide the model's st: Un texto opcional para guiar el estilo del modelo o continuar con un segmento de audio anterior. El indicador debe coincidir con el idioma de audio.
es.The sampling temperature, between 0 and: La temperatura de muestreo, entre 0 y 1. Valores más altos como 0. hará que la salida sea más aleatoria, mientras que valores inferiores como 0.2 la harán más centrada y determinista.

pt.Controls randomness: Lowering results in: Controla aleatoriedade: Diminuir resulta em menos complementos aleatórios. À medida que a temperatura se aproxima de zero, o modelo se tornará determinístico e repetitivo.
pt.The maximum number of tokens to generate: O número máximo de tokens a gerar. O comprimento total de tokens de entrada e tokens gerados é limitado pelo comprimento do contexto do modelo.
pt.An alternative to sampling with temperat: Uma alternativa à amostragem com temperatura, chamada amostragem núcleo, onde o modelo considera os resultados dos tokens com massa de probabilidade superior (P). Portanto, 0,1 significa que apenas os tokens que incluem a massa de probabilidade superior de 10% são considerados.
pt.Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive va: Número entre -2.0 e 2.0. Valores positivos penalizam novos tokens baseados em sua frequência existente no texto até agora, diminuindo a probabilidade do modelo repetir o verbal da mesma linha.
Número entre -2.0 e 2.0. Valores positivos penalizam novos tokens baseado no fato de eles aparecerem no texto até agora, aumentando a probabilidade do modelo de falar sobre novos tópicos.
pt.A memory key that will keep the chat his: Uma chave de memória que manterá o histórico de bate-papo compartilhado entre execuções e fluxos. Deixe em branco para deixar Groq sem memória das mensagens anteriores.
pt.Array of roles to specify more accurate: Array de papéis para especificar uma resposta mais precisa
pt.The audio file to transcribe. Supported: O arquivo de áudio a ser transcrito. Formatos suportados: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.
O modelo a ser usado para transcrição.
pt.The language of the input audio in ISO-6: O idioma do áudio de entrada no formato ISO-639-1 (por exemplo, "en" para inglês). Isso vai melhorar precisão e latência.
pt.An optional text to guide the model's st: Um texto opcional para guiar o estilo do modelo ou continuar um segmento de áudio anterior. O prompt deve corresponder ao idioma do áudio.
pt.The sampling temperature, between 0 and: A temperatura amostral, entre 0 e 1. Valores mais altos como 0. irá tornar a saída mais aleatória, enquanto valores mais baixos como 0,2 irão torná-lo mais focado e determinístico.
O formato da saída de transcrição.
pt.The audio file to translate. Supported f: O arquivo de áudio para traduzir. Formatos suportados: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.
O modelo a ser usado para tradução.
pt.An optional text in English to guide the: Um texto opcional em Inglês para guiar o estilo do modelo ou continuar um segmento de áudio anterior.
O formato da saída de tradução.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
